what: Gap vectors at which AMTOPA's verifier (revision b3b7784) refused a candidate at a terminal cell, in gap units (box coordinate / 4000), with the rigorous lower bound it reported there. Each round's cells are appended to the LP's cut pool before the next candidate is solved; the pool file itself is not rewritten, so the record of what the verifier taught the LP is here and readable.
